description:
T'au forces gather to invoke the Mont'ka against the Dark Angels, who have forced the T'au into a long and drawn-out engagement. The battle WILL end now.

Sean joins us as a guest for the launch of the 11th edition and will be helping present the Dark Angels in today's match against Luka and the T'au.
